claims.text: DIA scheduled a 19 Nov 2009 4:45pm briefing of Reid in SVC-217 to tell him the deliverables 'do not meet the criteria as specified in DoD 5200.1-R to justify the additional protection provided by a SAP.'

A DIA talking paper for a 19 November 2009 4:45pm meeting in SVC-217 records that the Deputy Secretary of Defense would tell Reid the AAWSAP deliverables do not meet DoD 5200.1-R criteria for SAP protection.
